title: [3.0-beta9] pump history - entries order
body:
I suggest to have the order of items in the pump history window (my is from Dana-R) ordered by timestamp descending, as it was in previous versions. Currently it is ascending and the newest items (most important) are reachable only after long scrolling.

![Screenshot_20211204-200851_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24793786/144721890-ccb3742d-3e8c-440d-adf4-dddc87c8454e.jpg)
